export const isPlanetId = (id: unknown): id is PlanetId => {
  return typeof id === 'string' && solarSystemData.some((body) => body.id === id);
};

export const getCelestialBodyById = (id: CelestialBody['id']): CelestialBody | undefined => {
  const found = solarSystemData.find((body) => body.id === id);
  return found ? (found as CelestialBody) : undefined;
};
